notes.content:

notes.title: Ghost Trick Available Now!
notes.content:
A remastering of the supernatural puzzle-solving thriller from Shu Takumi is out now!
Check out the launch trailer! 

[previewyoutube=D5po_6bO9eg;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring
- Revived high resolution graphics
- Newly rearranged music and 1 new track
- A new collection feature for art and BGM tracks

Demo version also available!
